fact: Paratus launched Paratus Lesotho on 5 November 2026, and its Starlink-enabled Paratus Essential Access has been available in Lesotho since April 2026, after Starlink's April 2025 licence and entry in June 2025 via reseller T-Connect.
title: Above 1,000m: can Starlink resellers solve Lesotho's connectivity problem?
